name: ironwallengraving-paymentCompletedOutboxDrainer-schedule
description: Scheduled background trigger that runs the paymentCompletedOutboxDrainer Lambda every minute. It drains durable payment-completed outbox rows and publishes eligible events to the payment-completed SNS topic.

name: ironwallengraving-inventoryReservationDrainer-schedule
description: Scheduled background trigger that runs the inventoryReservationDrainer Lambda every minute. It releases expired inventory reservations and retries blocked reservation-release work.
